name: A Little Help From My Friends
label: Quest
description: A Little Help From My Friends: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I was exploring this area, when all of a sudden, the heat just became unbearable. I must be suffering from heat exhaustion.
Please, help me get back to my friend Spraggle at Marshal's Refuge. I think I'm well enough to follow you there.
I am feeling a little out of it, so if I do happen to faint again, just splash some water on me from Spraggle's canteen. That should work, I hope...

clips.title: Progress
paras: I've been so worried about Ringo...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ringo's not in the best shape, friend, but I am glad to have him back in one piece!
